text:
priya (Product PM): Quick sync — we're drafting the Onramp Playbook for new customers that need multi-region + tenancy isolation. Need help defining SLA buckets, routing constraints, and launch acceptance criteria. TL;DR: propose 3 buckets (pilot, scale, enterprise) with routing policies per bucket. Thoughts? @matt @anya

matt (Eng): +1. Can we list constraints per bucket? e.g., latency SLO, affinity, failover region, allowed model variants.

anya (Platform Eng): Agree. For pilot: soft isolation (shared slices), SLO 200ms p95, can use best-effort fallback. For enterprise: dedicated slices, 99.95% uptime, cross-region replication, KMS integration.

oscar (SRE): Need playbook for evacuation and capacity commit for enterprise. Also ingress/egress cost limits and throttles. Suggest a canary window before cutover.

priya (Product PM): Good. Also need launch criteria checklist: perf on 3 workload profiles, chaos test pass, routing guardrails in place, automated rollback policy, and runbook verified by SRE.

anya (Platform Eng): Proposed config snippet for spec draft:
```yaml
onramp:
  buckets: [pilot, scale, enterprise]
  pilot:
    isolation: shared
    p95_latency_ms: 200
    fallback_policy: best_effort
  scale:
    isolation: soft_dedicated
    p95_latency_ms: 150
    affinity: regional
  enterprise:
    isolation: dedicated
    sla_pct: "99.95"
    residency: strict
    kms_required: true
```

matt (Eng): Nice. Callouts: quantization and KV cache behavior will differ by bucket; model-variant mapping required so routing can fallback to cheaper variants gracefully. Also need perf regression gates tied to prompt sets.

priya (Product PM): Customer-driven asks to capture up-front: bank-A requires data residency + HSM; gaming-studio wants jitter <80ms; analytics vendor needs burst capacity guarantees. We should allow per-customer routing overrides with strict precedence rules.

oscar (SRE): Ops note: per-customer overrides require policy precedence and complicate autoscaler decisions — add mandatory canary and auto-evict thresholds. Also include capacity reservation billing flag for dedicated slices.

priya (Product PM): Proposed launch acceptance criteria (short):
- Perf: p95 within target for small/medium/large prompt profiles on dedicated and shared variants.
- Resilience: failover to secondary region within Xs for enterprise.
- Security: KMS/HSM + audit logs verified.
- Observability: route-level latency, token-cost, and regression alerts in Console.
- Ops: evacuation runbook + rollback tested.

infra-bot: created task BOARD-987 for onramp-spec draft

matt (Eng): Ack — I'll map perf targets to infra cost estimates by Tue.

anya (Platform Eng): Ack, I'll draft the technical spec for buckets and routing guardrails by EOW and include a fallback matrix for model variants and quantization profiles.

oscar (SRE): I'll add runbook additions and required canary windows to BOARD-987.

priya (Product PM): Thanks — if anyone has existing eval prompt sets for bank/gaming workloads please drop links in the thread. Planning to present a one-pager to GTM next Wed. :calendar:
